crossRefs.note: If a man dies, will he live again? I would wait all the days of my warfare, until my release should come.
“Isn’t a man forced to labor on earth? Aren’t his days like the days of a hired hand?
in whose hand is the life of every living thing, and the breath of all mankind?
“Yahweh, show me my end, what is the measure of my days. Let me know how frail I am.
“This is the interpretation of the thing: MENE: God has counted your kingdom, and brought it to an end.
In that night Belshazzar the Chaldean King was slain.
“Seventy weeks are decreed on your people and on your holy city, to finish disobedience, and to make an end of sins…
“The king will do according to his will. He will exalt himself, and magnify himself above every god, and will speak…
“But God said to him, ‘You foolish one, tonight your soul is required of you. The things which you have prepared—whose…
He made from one blood every nation of men to dwell on all the surface of the earth, having determined appointed…
Inasmuch as it is appointed for men to die once, and after this, judgment,
For what does he care for his house after him, when the number of his months is cut off?
But he stands alone, and who can oppose him? What his soul desires, even that he does.
For he performs that which is appointed for me. Many such things are with him.
You have set a boundary that they may not pass over, that they don’t turn again to cover the earth.
You hide your face; they are troubled. You take away their breath; they die and return to the dust.
All the inhabitants of the earth are reputed as nothing; and he does according to his will in the army of heaven, and…
and the Living one. I was dead, and behold, I am alive forever and ever. Amen. I have the keys of Death and of Hades.
“To the angel of the assembly in Philadelphia write: “He who is holy, he who is true, he who has the key of David, he…

translations.web: Seeing his days are determined, the number of his months is with you, and you have appointed his bounds that he can’t pass;
translations.bsb: Since his days are determined and the number of his months is with You, and since You have set limits that he cannot exceed,
translations.kjv: Seeing his days are determined, the number of his months are with thee, thou hast appointed his bounds that he cannot pass;
